Callout.Name: Informant - Missed Meeting
Callout.Message: Informant has not made a scheduled meeting.
Callout.Advisory: Meeting point is a car park, nobody answering the phone.

Script.Line: I have not seen him since Tuesday. He said he would be here.
He was jumpy last time. More than usual.
If he has gone somewhere it is not because of me.

Lines.Briefing: An informant who does not turn up is either frightened or turned.
Lines.Approach: The meeting was at eight and nobody has seen them. That is not like them.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
